# Permanent Equity

> Permanent Equity is a private equity firm that buys and holds great companies for the long term. Based in Columbia, Missouri, we invest out of 30-year funds, meaning no forced exits, no quick flips, and no pressure to sell portfolio companies. We focus on preserving teams, culture, and legacy while resourcing businesses for long-term growth.

## About

Permanent Equity was founded in 2007 by Brent Beshore. Unlike traditional private equity firms that buy companies to sell them within 3-7 years, we are structured to hold investments indefinitely. We have never sold a portfolio company.

Our approach is sometimes called "permanent capital" or "long-duration investing." We believe the best outcomes for companies, employees, and communities come from patient, aligned ownership—not financial engineering or forced timelines.

## Who We Work With

We partner with owners of profitable, established businesses who care what happens to their company after they sell. Our typical seller is a founder or family owner who has built something meaningful and wants to ensure their team and culture are protected.

We also work with investors seeking exposure to permanent capital strategies—those looking for long-term compounding without the traditional PE fund lifecycle.

## Investment Approach

We acquire controlling stakes in profitable North American businesses. We look for:

- Established companies with consistent profitability
- Strong management teams and healthy cultures
- Products or services with durable demand
- Owners who want a partner, not just a buyer

We are industry-agnostic but have experience in services, manufacturing, distribution, and software.

What we do after acquiring a company:

- Keep existing management and teams in place
- Provide capital and resources for growth
- Maintain operational independence
- Hold the company long-term (we have never sold a portfolio company)

What we do not do:

- Load companies with debt
- Cut staff to boost short-term returns
- Flip companies to other buyers
- Force exits based on fund timelines
